# Vocabulary in Context Detective Mat

Subject: ELA
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Student Mat
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A reusable mat for figuring out unfamiliar words with context clues, word parts, and sentence testing.

## Alignment Note
Supports vocabulary acquisition through context, morphology, and academic language routines.

## Classroom Use Case
Laminate for partner reading or use as a notebook insert during independent reading conferences.

## Preview Content
- Clue words around it
- Word parts I recognize
- My best meaning and test sentence

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
